name: Stems
about: Splits a recording into vocals, drums, bass and other — on the device, offline.
heavy.desc: Splits any library recording into four stems: vocals, drums, bass and other. A backing track without the voice, the bass part on its own, drums on their own — for practice and for the studio. HTDemucs model, 180 MB, runs on the device.
empty: No recordings in the library. Record in the voice recorder or looper, or add a file in the library.
done.title: Separated
est: Takes about {t}. The screen may go off, but keep the app in front.
saved: Done: four stems in the library
err.load: The model did not load. In the web version this module is unavailable.
help.what: Stems: any library recording → vocals, drums, bass, other.
help.1: Tap a recording to separate it. The four stems go to the library next to the original.
help.2: “Open in the studio” — a project with four audio tracks: play along to the backing, learn a part, build your own version.
help.3: Runs on the device, a few minutes per song; not in the web version.
